decisions.reason: Audio and web conferencing is crowded and weakly differentiated versus the firm's network-centric strengths, so resources are better shifted to core infrastructure and newer software-defined services.
Metropolitan data centre connectivity fits directly with enterprise cloud and interconnection demand and is strongly supported by the firm's owned network footprint and prior market adoption.
Optical spectrum connectivity uses the firm's fibre assets and supports high-bandwidth, low-latency enterprise needs, making it strategically close to the firm's direction of travel.
The voice number ordering portal improves automation and self-service in line with real-time provisioning goals, even if it is more of an enabling feature than a flagship offer.
Direct voice network connection still complements managed enterprise communications, but voice remains a mature segment with lower growth and higher risk of future rationalisation.
